lead.question: 消防员扑灭加州森林大火后，是如何一步步查明这场离奇大火的起因的？
lead.warmup: 一场森林大火刚被扑灭，起因却成谜。按经验，森林火灾多半由碎玻璃聚光或随手丢弃的烟头引燃，可消防队员仔细查看地面后毫无所获。直到第二天上午，一名消防队员偶然发现一条缠在 16000 伏高压线上的死蛇：鸟把蛇抓起丢到电线上，蛇缠住电线后火花落地，瞬间点燃森林。
goals: 区分现在完成时、现在完成进行时与一般过去时的用法
掌握 put out、find out、at last、accidentally、in this way 等短语
辨清 cause 与 reason、drop 与 fall 的词义与搭配
能用被动语态复述起火原因与扑灭经过
lead.summary: 本课以加州森林大火为线索对比三种时态：现在完成时 have put out（火已扑灭）、现在完成进行时 have been trying（从那时查到现在）、一般过去时 examined 与 discovered（叙述经过）。情节先排除碎玻璃和烟头，再借高压线上的蛇尸揭开真相。
lead.tips: 现在完成进行时强调动作从过去持续至今且可能继续（have been trying，常配 since then）；remains 表“残骸、尸体”只有复数形式。

questions.zh: 是什么引起了这场火灾？
questions.a: A snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16,000-volt power line caused it. When the snake wound itself round the wires, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
questions.aZh: 是一条缠在16000伏高压线上的蛇。蛇缠住电线时把火花送到地面，火花立刻引发了大火。
questions.hint: dropped it on to the wires → wound itself round the wires → sent sparks down to the ground。

questions.q: Why were the firemen sure that neither broken glass nor a cigarette end started the fire?
questions.zh: 消防队员为什么断定这场火既不是碎玻璃也不是烟头引起的？
questions.a: Because they examined the ground carefully yesterday but were not able to find any broken glass, and they were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
questions.aZh: 因为他们昨天仔细查看了地面却没找到碎玻璃，同时也十分肯定不是烟头起的火。
questions.hint: examined the ground carefully 与 were quite sure。

questions.q: How did the snake start the fire according to the explanation?
questions.zh: 按照文中的解释，蛇是怎样引发这场火灾的？
questions.a: A bird snatched up the snake from the ground and dropped it on to the wires. The snake then wound itself round the wires and sent sparks down to the ground.
questions.aZh: 一只鸟把蛇从地上抓起来丢到电线上，蛇缠住电线后把火花送到地面。
questions.hint: snatched up…dropped it on to the wires…sent sparks down。

questions.q: Why does the lesson use 'have put out' but 'have been trying to find out'?
questions.zh: 为什么课文用 have put out，却用 have been trying to find out？
questions.a: 'Have put out' is the present perfect: the fire is out. 'Have been trying' is the present perfect progressive: they started trying after the fire and are still trying to find out the cause.
questions.aZh: have put out 表火已扑灭；have been trying 表从那时起一直查到现在，仍在继续。
questions.hint: at last…have put out 与 since then…have been trying。

questions.q: Why is the lesson titled 'Hot snake'?
questions.zh: 课文标题为什么叫 Hot snake？
questions.a: The snake was not hot because of the fire. It was wound round a 16,000-volt power line, so it was carrying electricity, got hot and was killed. The title is a play on words.
questions.aZh: 蛇不是被火烤热的，而是缠在16000伏高压线上带电发烫而死；hot 一语双关。
questions.hint: 结合 the remains of a snake…a 16,000-volt power line。

exercises.q: 选词填空（at last / put out / find out）：① ______ firemen have ______ a big forest fire in California. ② Since then, they have been trying to ______ how the fire began.
exercises.a: At last; put out; find out
exercises.note: put out 扑灭；find out 查明。

exercises.q: 词形转换并填空：accident → accidental → ______（副词）。a fireman ______ discovered the cause.
exercises.note: 形容词加 -ly 构成副词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：森林火灾时常由碎玻璃或人们随手扔掉的香烟头引起。
exercises.a: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.

exercises.q: 用所给动词的正确时态填空：Since then, they ______ (try) to find out how the fire began.
exercises.note: since then 常配现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: 改写为被动语态：a cigarette end did not start the fire → the fire ______ ______ ______ by a cigarette end.
用 since 合并为含原因状语从句的句子：The firemen had no idea how the fire began. They examined the ground carefully.
exercises.a: Since the firemen had no idea how the fire began, they examined the ground carefully.

exercises.q: 根据课文填空：A bird ______ ______ the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the ______ of a 16,000-volt power ______; the snake wound itself round them and sent ______ down to the ground.

quiz.q: 消防队员们“终于扑灭”了加利福尼亚的一场森林大火，文中用的动词短语是？
options: put out
put off
put up
put down

quiz.q: “从那时起，他们一直试图找出起火的原因”，正确的英文表达是？
options: They tried to find out how the fire began.
They have tried to find out how the fire began.
They have been trying to find out how the fire began.
They are trying to find out how the fire began.

quiz.q: 消防队员昨天仔细查看地面后，没有找到什么？
options: a cigarette end
any broken glass
the remains of a snake
some sparks on the ground
quiz.note: were not able to find any broken glass。

quiz.q: 消防队员发现的蛇的残骸缠在哪里？
options: round a tree near the forest
on the ground of the forest
round the neck of a bird
round the electric wires of a 16,000-volt power line

quiz.q: 蛇是怎样把火花送到地面从而引起火灾的？
options: By winding itself round the wires.
By biting the electric wires.
By falling on to the dry grass.
By being dropped on to the ground.
quiz.note: wound itself round the wires → sent sparks down。

quiz.q: “In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.”句中的 in this way 指的是什么？
options: By examining the ground carefully once more
By questioning the people in the forest
By noticing the remains of the snake wound round the wires
By reading a report about forest fires
quiz.note: 指上文偶然发现死蛇这一方式。
